title: Evaluating Large Language Models on Iranian Doctoral Entrance Exams in Electrical and Computer Engineering
abstract: arXiv:2611.31263v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We evaluate four large language models (LLMs) on multiple-choice questions from the 2024 and 2025 Iranian national Ph.D. entrance examinations in Electrical Engineering (EE) and Computer Engineering (CE). Of the 440 questions in the four official booklets, 7 were excluded because the question statement or its figure was ambiguous, leaving 433 questions (186 EE, 247 CE), of which 171 (39.5\%) depend on a figure. Each question was presented in the original Persian and in an English translation, giving 3,464 scored responses. GPT-5, Gemini 2.5 Pro, Claude Sonnet 4.5 and Grok 4 were queried zero-shot, with reasoning enabled, through a single commercial web interface (Perplexity) in October 2025, using an automated script. Because every model answers the same items, all inferences use paired tests or question-clustered models. translated_title: 评估大型语言模型在伊朗电气与计算机工程博士入学考试中的表现
translated_abstract: 我们在2024年和2025年伊朗国家电气工程（EE）与计算机工程（CE）博士入学考试的多项选择题上评估了四个大型语言模型（LLM）。四本官方试题册共有440道题，其中7道因题干或配图存在歧义而被排除，剩余433道题（EE 186道，CE 247道），其中171道（39.5%）依赖配图。每道题均以原始波斯语和英语翻译两种版本呈现，共产生3,464个评分回答。2025年10月，通过自动化脚本经由单一商业网页接口（Perplexity）以零样本方式（开启推理功能）查询了GPT-5、Gemini 2.5 Pro、Claude Sonnet 4.5和Grok 4。由于每个模型回答相同的题目，所有统计推断均采用配对检验或按题目聚类的模型。准确率分为两个层级：GPT-5（79.9%，95% CI 76.6–83.1）和Gemini 2.5 Pro（78.4%，74.8–81.9）……
tldr: 该研究利用伊朗电气与计算机工程博士入学考试的真实试题（含波斯语与英语双语及依赖配图的题目），通过统一的统计方法系统评估了GPT-5、Gemini 2.5 Pro、Claude Sonnet 4.5和Grok 4四个大型语言模型的答题准确率。
en_tdlr: This study systematically evaluates four LLMs (GPT-5, Gemini 2.5 Pro, Claude Sonnet 4.5, and Grok 4) on real questions from Iranian national Ph.D. entrance exams in Electrical and Computer Engineering, presented in both Persian and English and including figure-dependent items, using rigorous paired statistical analysis.
